ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution with approximately 68% high-intensity white/cream pixels and 32% low-intensity black pixels.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant white contiguous regions in the center of both lobes; a central black isosceles-trapezoid-like blob at the peduncle/notch interface; scattered black circular spots (mottling) localized on the mid-left lobe; thick black pigmentation border along the entire trailing edge.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Calculated V-shaped internal angle of approximately 52 degrees; vertical depth from the fluke lobe apex line to the notch base is approximately 14% of the total vertical height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, non-periodic serrations along the trailing edge; right lobe exhibits a series of three larger-amplitude (approx. 10-15 pixel) depressions compared to the left lobe's smaller, more uniform serrations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave mathematical curve fitted to the trailing edge sweep; convex curve fitted to the leading edge, converging at acute, terminally-pointed tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Spatial cluster of approximately 10-12 dark circular pixels on the left lobe, centered mid-lobe; smaller cluster of 3 spots near the right distal tip.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Set of 4-5 near-vertical, low-intensity linear rake marks on the inner-mid region of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct, deep irregular notch/indentation on the trailing edge of the right lobe, likely indicative of previous trauma or predation attempt.
other_distinctive_markers: Presence of yellowish-brown discoloration (diatom/biofilm) overlaying the primary white pigmentation on the lower thirds of both lobes.
